title: totalfloat history accept --json, and history reject --json
description: A decision on a proposal. Who decided, when and why is kept with the proposal (see reviews in totalfloat.changeset/1).

replayed.description: True if the branch had moved on, so the proposal was replayed on its head as a new changeset.

recorded.description: The changeset now on the branch: the proposal itself, the replayed one, or null.
